messages.question: What boot type or material would you like for the footwear?
messages.reply: Nothing in particular comes to mind, so surprise me.

messages.question: What material, lining or boot shaft height would you like for the footwear?
messages.reply: I'm open on that, so pick from whatever's on the shelf.

messages.question: What lining, boot shaft height or season would you like for the footwear?
messages.reply: Any of them will do for me, since I'm just here to tick the box.

goal: When the first cold mornings hit Joburg, my old pair always gives up the ghost, and this year they've split right across the sole. Fall/winter footwear is the category, and I'll take slip-on only, no laces, no buckles, no straps. Think of it as a quick exit stage left. Only what's on the shelf, please, nothing on back order. I'm at a desk most days, but my calendar holds a few other acts besides the ledgers, and these will be for one of them. I can spend 550 US cents, not a cent over, so that's the ceiling and the curtain comes down there. Total of 3 messages from your side, no more. The cupboard has room for whatever shape you can show me, so nothing's ruled out on that front. Wrap up inside 38 steps, otherwise it doesn't count. Nothing found? Just say so, and don't offer a substitute. Ask me what you need and I'll answer plainly, because I'd rather do the sums than guess.

listings_set.about_text: These adorable children's rain boots are perfect for keeping little feet dry and stylish. Made from high-quality PVC material, they are durable and easy to clean. The bright yellow color with a cute dinosaur design is sure to delight any child. These boots come in various sizes suitable for toddlers and young children, ensuring a comfortable fit. They feature a low heel (1-3CM) and a mid-calf height, making them easy to wear and walk in. Whether it's rainy days or just playing in the mud, these boots will keep your child's feet protected and happy.
